description: Monorepo scaffold + shared packages + infrastructure. Creates the entire directory skeleton, all package.json/tsconfig/turbo files, packages/config (tsconfig bases + ESLint + Prettier), packages/shared-types (enums + API envelope types), packages/validation (Zod schemas), Docker Compose (Postgres 15 + Redis 7 + Adminer), Prisma schema with all tables + RLS migration SQL, .env.example, and all documentation files. This FEAT is independent of all others and must complete first.
steps: Create rims/ root files: package.json (pnpm workspace, turbo scripts, @rims/* package names, pnpm@9.12.0 engine), pnpm-workspace.yaml (apps/*, packages/*), turbo.json (build/dev/lint/test/type-check tasks with correct dependsOn), .gitignore (node_modules, dist, .env, prisma/migrations/dev.db), .nvmrc (20), README.md (project overview + quick start).

Create packages/config/: package.json (@rims/config), tsconfig.base.json (strict, ES2022, commonjs, composite, decorators, emitDecoratorMetadata — copy pattern from /Users/macbookpro/Desktop/ProgrammoCeuticals/ectd/ectd-platform/tsconfig.base.json), tsconfig.nestjs.json (extends ./tsconfig.base.json, commonjs module), tsconfig.vite.json (extends ./tsconfig.base.json, ESNext module, bundler moduleResolution, jsx react-jsx), .eslintrc.js (@typescript-eslint/recommended + prettier plugin), index.js (empty — config is referenced by path not import).

Create packages/shared-types/: package.json (@rims/shared-types, main: dist/index.js, types: dist/index.d.ts), tsconfig.json (extends @rims/config/tsconfig.base.json), src/enums.ts (UserStatus, TenantStatus, EmployeeStatus, SubscriptionStatus, InvitationStatus, PermissionScope, AuditOutcome, DepartmentStatus, TeamStatus, RoleScope), src/types.ts (PaginatedResult<T>, ApiResponse<T>, ApiError, ApiPaginatedResponse<T>, JwtPayload with sub/email/tenantId/permissions), src/index.ts (re-exports all).

Create packages/validation/: package.json (@rims/validation, peer dep zod@3), tsconfig.json, src/auth.schemas.ts (loginSchema, forgotPasswordSchema, resetPasswordSchema, acceptInvitationSchema), src/user.schemas.ts (inviteUserSchema, updateUserSchema), src/organization.schemas.ts (updateInstitutionSchema, createDepartmentSchema, updateDepartmentSchema, createTeamSchema), src/employee.schemas.ts (createEmployeeSchema, updateEmployeeSchema), src/pagination.schemas.ts (paginationQuerySchema), src/index.ts.

Create prisma/schema.prisma. All models: Tenant (id, name, slug, status, logoUrl, createdAt, updatedAt, @@map('tenants')), TenantDomain (@@map tenant_domains), TenantSettings (@@map tenant_settings), TenantModuleEntitlement (@@map tenant_module_entitlements), SubscriptionPlan (@@map subscription_plans), Subscription (@@map subscriptions), User (id, email, passwordHash, firstName, lastName, status, tenantId FK, createdAt, updatedAt, @@map users, @@index([tenantId,status])), UserTenantMembership (@@map user_tenant_memberships), Session (id, userId, tenantId, tokenHash, expiresAt, revokedAt, ipAddress, userAgent, @@map sessions), Role (id, tenantId, name, scope, isSystem, @@map roles, @@index([tenantId])), Permission (id, code, description, scope, @@map permissions), RolePermission (@@map role_permissions), UserRoleAssignment (@@map user_role_assignments), Invitation (id, tenantId, email, token, tokenHash, type, expiresAt, usedAt, invitedByUserId, @@map invitations, @@index([tenantId,type])), Institution (id, tenantId @unique, name, type, address, @@map institutions), Department (id, tenantId, name, parentId self-ref, status, archivedAt, @@map departments, @@index([tenantId,status])), Team (id, tenantId, departmentId, name, status, @@map teams), Position (@@map positions), Employee (id, tenantId, userId nullable FK, firstName, lastName, status, departmentId, positionId, hireDate, archivedAt, @@map employees, @@index([tenantId,status,departmentId])), EmployeeQualification (@@map employee_qualifications), EmployeeSkill (@@map employee_skills), EmploymentRecord (@@map employment_records), AuditEvent (id, tenantId, actorId, action, resourceType, resourceId, outcome, beforeState Json, afterState Json, ipAddress, userAgent, requestId, createdAt, @@map audit_events, @@index([tenantId,resourceType,createdAt])). All PKs @id @default(uuid()). All column names @map(snake_case).

Create prisma/migrations/0001_rls_setup/migration.sql: CREATE ROLE app_role LOGIN PASSWORD '...' NOINHERIT; CREATE ROLE migration_role BYPASSRLS; GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE rims_dev TO app_role; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO app_role; GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_role; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES GRANT SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE ON TABLES TO app_role; Enable RLS (ALTER TABLE tenants ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ... repeat for every tenant-owned table); CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON <table> USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true)::uuid); CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_tenant_context(p_tenant_id uuid) RETURNS void AS $$ BEGIN PERFORM set_config('app.current_tenant_id', p_tenant_id::text, true); END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

Create docker-compose.yml: postgres service (image: postgres:15-alpine, container: rims_postgres, env POSTGRES_USER=rims_dev POSTGRES_PASSWORD=rims_dev_secret POSTGRES_DB=rims_dev, port 5432:5432, healthcheck pg_isready, named volume postgres_data), redis service (image: redis:7-alpine, container: rims_redis, port 6379:6379, healthcheck redis-cli ping, named volume redis_data), adminer service (image: adminer:4, port 8080:8080, depends_on postgres). Create infra/docker/postgres/init.sql (CREATE USER rims_app WITH PASSWORD 'rims_app_secret'; GRANT ALL ON DATABASE rims_dev TO rims_app;).

Create .env.example with all variables: DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL (uses migration_role), REDIS_URL, JWT_ACCESS_SECRET, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRY=15m, JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRY=7d, NODE_ENV, PORT=3000, VITE_API_URL, CORS_ORIGIN, THROTTLE_TTL=60, THROTTLE_LIMIT=100, SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, SMTP_FROM, SEED_DEMO=true. Each line has a comment explaining purpose and whether required.

Create all documentation files: docs/PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md (high-level product summary, user personas, core modules), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (system diagram description, technology choices + rationale, monorepo structure, request lifecycle with RLS), docs/DATABASE_DESIGN.md (entity descriptions, key relationships, tenancy model, RLS approach), docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md (copy of plan.md summary), docs/OPEN_DECISIONS.md (argon2 native build, CSRF cross-origin, email provider, file storage), docs/decisions/ADR-001-monorepo.md, ADR-002-modular-monolith.md, ADR-003-tenant-isolation.md. Each ADR: Status/Context/Decision/Consequences.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm install from rims/ root exits 0
pnpm turbo run build --dry lists all 8 workspaces (api, web, worker, shared-types, validation, api-client, ui, config)
docker compose up -d starts postgres, redis, adminer all healthy
All documentation files exist and are non-empty
verification: docker compose up -d && sleep 5 && docker compose ps
findings: 1. Docker is not available in the agent execution environment — `docker compose up -d` acceptance criterion cannot be verified by the agent, but docker-compose.yml is correct (postgres:15-alpine, redis:7-alpine, adminer:4, healthchecks, named volumes). Verify manually once Docker Desktop is installed. 2. Vite version pinned to 5.4.11 (from 6.0.1) to avoid esbuild@0.24.2 postinstall SIGKILL on first install attempt; a second install attempt succeeded with 6.0.1 but 5.4.11 is safer for CI. FEAT-002 may upgrade Vite if desired. 3. apps/web package.json uses React 18.3.1 (not 19) for type compatibility with current @types/react; upgrade to React 19 can happen in FEAT-004 when the UI is built out. 4. DATABASE_URL must be set in environment for `pnpm prisma validate` — agent used `DATABASE_URL=postgresql://... pnpm prisma validate` inline; add DATABASE_URL to .env before running Prisma commands. 5. All 8 workspace packages (api, web, worker, shared-types, validation, api-client, ui, config) confirmed by `pnpm turbo run build --dry`.
